items.t: Morgan Stanley Maintains Equal-Weight on Royal Caribbean Group, Raises Price Target to $330
items.sum: Morgan Stanley analyst Jamie Rollo maintains Royal Caribbean Group (NYSE:RCL) with a Equal-Weight and raises the price target from $300 to $330.

items.t: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Royal Caribbean (RCL) on Nov. 9
items.sum: ETFs sold a net $21.7 million of Royal Caribbean on Monday, Nov. 9.

items.t: Royal Caribbean Stocks Rise 3.36% as Oil Slide Lifts Cruise Shares
items.sum: Cheaper crude helped cruise lines rally, but 58% fuel hedging means the earnings impact is smaller than the move suggests.

items.t: RCL Targets Adjusted EPS in the $20 Range for 2027: Can Momentum Last?
items.sum: Royal Caribbean targets adjusted EPS in the $20 range for 2027, backed by bookings strength, capacity growth and cost control.
